# Yowie
Yowie are a once-thought urban myth, turned newly discovered mystical species of bipedal hairy creature. From discussions had between our species, it seems historically they were living beside humanity during its existence on Earth in parts of Australia, lending them to develop a thick australian accent with slang included.
## Unique Abilities
### Fuckin' skiz, mate
- They seem to have spent most of their time experimenting with some of the most dangerous and experimental drugs, and on review, they've built up a bigger tolerance to most chemicals. Uniquely, their liver carries out the task of metabolizing chemicals.
## Diet
- Due to their resistance to most drugs and toxins, they are able to consume almost any edible items.
## Benefits
- They take 25% less Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage. - Their stature makes their unarmed punch deal [color=#ec3a3a]2x the damage[/color] of a human punch. - Their fur allows them to take [color=#1e90ff]less cold damage[/color]. - They weigh more, allowing them to pull lighter species with ease.
## Drawbacks
- Their body is larger than most other species in stature, with the downside of them [color=#ffa500]not being able to fit into most Nanotrasen external wear or shoes[/color] (they can barely squeeze into softsuits) - They are unable to be carried by others. - They are easier to hit due to their size.
